parsed.why: Layered, operating protections: bathroom access law, hate-crime conviction, sanctuary statute, court order forcing care resumption. Above the 0.35 parent; visitor still carries national document/border exposure.

Low-risk tier, functioning discrimination enforcement, X licences, care sanctuary city; no facility ban and sports bills stalled. But no hate-crime statute and thin statewide statute layer lift it only modestly above parent.

Statewide facility exclusion with criminal trespass, licence-marker fraud rule, care bans reaching adults, dual travel advisories; national court reversed the pro-trans restroom ruling. Adds hostile layer below parent.

Upheld minor care ban, custody care ban without taper, surgical-proof document rules, reporting tipline, no gender-identity non-discrimination law. Hostile additions below the 0.35 parent, though no facility-criminalisation regime.

Most-protective tier: public-accommodation coverage, X markers without medical proof, panic-defence ban, shield order for visiting care-seekers, lowest per-capita killing rate. Well above parent; national layer still binds.
